spans.text: eWAVE variety ID: 16 Variety type: High-contact L1 varieties (L1c) As the label suggests, the varieties in this group are characterized by a high degree of contact between different dialects of English and/or between English and other languages.

DESCRIPTION (from the eWAVE chapter on this variety) ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Varieties of rural, or “non-metro” African American Vernacular English (AAVE), are spoken by several million working-class African Americans living in small, more-geographically remote communities in the Southern United States, though there are some representative rural African American communities in the Northern United States and in Canada.
